audience: developers and support teams who run in-app chat with Stream Chat

useCases.title: Find messages that mention a topic
useCases.text: The AI searches messages across channels with a channel filter and a full-text query, for example refund. You see what was said and where.

useCases.title: Read a channel and its latest messages
useCases.text: The AI finds channels with a filter, then reads one channel's members and most recent messages. It sums up the conversation.

useCases.title: Follow a thread and its reactions
useCases.text: The AI lists threads, reads the replies under a parent message and the reactions on a message.

useCases.title: Check a user and their unread messages
useCases.text: The AI finds users with a filter and reads the total and per-channel unread and mention counts for one user.

useCases.title: Post a message or a reaction as a user
useCases.text: The AI posts a message to a channel, or adds a reaction to a message, as an existing user of the app. This posts real content.
